title: Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
summary: Drink to gain one level 2 spell slot until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle for one level 2 spell slot. This replaces another ordinary elixir.
fields.Expiry: Losing the condition removes a level 2 slot, prioritizing an already expended slot. Consecutive doses of this same elixir do not refill it. Alternating it with another elixir can restore it.
fields.Warlock use: A fixed level 2 Spellcasting slot that can cast Warlock spells. It is separate from Pact Magic and does not refresh on Short Rest.
fields.Lower-level casters: A caster with no natural level 2 slots can use it to upcast known spells. It does not teach new spells.
fields.Crafting: Combine Suspension of Laculite with any Vitriol.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
